name: jessegall/code-commandments
description: An architecture compiler — judges a PHP, Vue, TypeScript, Python and C# codebase against architectural disciplines and points every violation at the skill that fixes it

scripts.readme: scripts/dev env GOMEMLIMIT=3GiB GOMAXPROCS=2 go run ./cli/doc/readme
sins: scripts/dev env GOMEMLIMIT=3GiB GOMAXPROCS=2 go run ./skill/render/generate
scripts/dev env GOMEMLIMIT=3GiB GOMAXPROCS=2 go run ./cli/doc/refresh
